$Comment: The Headless Horseman's graveyard: the source prefab beside this file (an enclosed night graveyard,
64 by 110 blocks; players arrive at its anchor in the entrance room), with the fight's entity on the open
road just south of the central plaza (the script raises his Head and adds around it, so it stands
clear of the plaza's centrepiece), his spawn marker on the plaza's north side, and a vanilla
Leave_Instance pad against the entrance room's back wall, the way out. Cells count from the anchor.
His fight's reach and leash (ArenaRange, LeashRange and the rest, in both his fights' scripts) are
measured from the fight's entity, so move them with its cell.
His spawn marker sits 7 cells north of the fountain's centre (X 0, Z 53), and his flight in the saddle
fountain laps from where he spawns, so move the marker and those offsets together.
The six Orbis_Boss_Health_Pack points are where his fight's health packs may drop: 4 cells over
open ground (no grave, wall or fountain under them), two north of the plaza, one either side of
the fountain and two south of it, so a pack falls straight to the floor.
Containers stocks the source's hidden chest, in a sealed treasure room inside the west rock reached
down a cobwebbed shaft, from Server/Drops/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Drop_Graveyard_Chest.json: every
paste places it full again, and the first player to open it takes what it holds.
